scope: online decoder-controller computation and update interface

compute_domains.name: FPGA deterministic and safety domain
owns: local event FSM and health counters
active parameter bank and atomic commit
must_not: block on host inference or transport
run online training or unconstrained optimization
apply a late action to a later cycle

compute_domains.name: host estimation and optimization domain
owns: deployable estimator, teacher replay or bounded optimization
must_not: treat sent parameters as committed without readback
consume target_params in a deployable mode

timescales.name: per-subcycle FPGA fast path
timescales.trigger: one valid syndrome or protocol event observation
inputs: wrapped syndrome_q and syndrome_p or classified event
local frame, run-length and health state
outputs: normal, recovery, hold, reset-request or fallback action kind
trace record with actual active version
timescales.deadline: action must be ready for the same protocol boundary; reference budget 1.5 us within a 5 us configured subcycle
timescales.failure_action: suppress late or invalid action, use frame-only hold or safe action, increment reason counter; never shift a late correction to the next cycle
timescales.current_gap: budget violation is recorded but does not suppress the callback; event-validity and action-kind FSM are incomplete

timescales.name: window event and health aggregation
timescales.trigger: window emission and any urgent local event
inputs: g, e and leakage event counts and run lengths when available
saturation, overflow, deadline, fallback and lost-trace counters
outputs: health state and reason-coded local transition
ordered host notification without blocking TS1
timescales.deadline: urgent safety transitions execute locally by the next safe cycle boundary; window serialization may lag but must preserve sequence and loss accounting
timescales.failure_action: reject an invalid whole window, keep TS1 running, drop oldest queued window when bounded queue is full, and retain local safety authority
timescales.current_gap: current payload is normalized float32 with no header CRC/n_valid wire block; g/e/leakage FSM and automatic local fallback are absent

timescales.name: host slow estimation and optimization
timescales.trigger: eligible validated window or slower cross-window/cross-run schedule
inputs: observed and validated TS2 payload only
prior active version and last-known-good parameters
offline training provenance when a learned model is used
outputs: schema, version, source-window, timestamps, apply_epoch and CRC
K and b plus optional versioned FSM parameters
commit request followed by ack and active-version readback
timescales.deadline: not a per-cycle deadline; reference start period is 20 ms and software job budget is 5 ms, but stale or late results must be rejected before commit
timescales.failure_action: do not stage a failed or stale result; continue last-known-good until max age, then switch locally to safe-static
timescales.current_gap: exceptions cause no stage, but slow budget violations are record-only and max-age, schema, CRC, CAS and commit readback are missing

cross_domain_interfaces.name: inactive parameter-bank staging
cross_domain_interfaces.atomicity: payload first, validated header last, never write active bank

cross_domain_interfaces.name: commit acknowledgement and readback
cross_domain_interfaces.atomicity: host success requires active-version readback, not send completion

atomic_update_protocol.rule: cycle starts by latching one active bank and version
host writes a complete inactive-bank payload
FPGA validates shape, finite/range, schema, length and CRC before staged-valid
commit checks monotonic new version and expected-active-version CAS
bank switch occurs once at a cycle boundary before that cycle fast action
ack reports reason and active version; host verifies readback
old bank remains last-known-good through a post-commit guard and can roll back
bank age and source-window freshness are checked before and after commit
at most one in-flight slow job and one pending commit; replacement is explicit

failure_matrix.required_action: frame-only hold or protocol reset request; no zero substitution
suppress late action and increment counter
bounded clip plus flag; persistent violation degrades health and selects safe-static
local event FSM acts without waiting for a window or host

failure_matrix.event: bad window schema, length, CRC or n_valid
failure_matrix.required_action: reject whole window and produce no update
drop oldest unprocessed window, retain newest and count loss

failure_matrix.event: slow estimator, DMA or inference failure
failure_matrix.required_action: do not stage; keep active last-known-good

failure_matrix.event: slow budget miss or stale result
failure_matrix.required_action: reject if freshness or future apply_epoch fails; never retroactively apply

failure_matrix.event: bad bank schema, CRC, range, version or CAS
failure_matrix.required_action: reject inactive bank and leave active bank unchanged

failure_matrix.event: commit ack timeout or readback mismatch
failure_matrix.required_action: do not assume success; read back or roll back

failure_matrix.event: host timeout or bank exceeds max age
failure_matrix.required_action: last-known-good until age limit, then local safe-static

failure_matrix.event: transport sequence gap, duplicate or corruption
failure_matrix.required_action: reject or explicitly retry, account loss, preserve TS1 operation

failure_matrix.event: boot, reset or no validated bank
hidden target_params consumed by deployable estimator
failure_matrix.required_action: invalidate deployable result; allow only explicitly labelled oracle or test lane

invariants: CD1 never waits for CD2 to produce the current-cycle action
one cycle consumes exactly one latched active version
late actions are not shifted to a later observation
urgent event safety action is local and is not delayed to window emission
invalid windows produce no host update
host writes only the inactive bank
partial or unverifiable bank payloads never activate
send completion is not commit success
deployable estimators consume observed channels only
all configured timing numbers remain non-measured until CL3 evidence exists

scheduler_cycle_order: finish slow job and possibly stage
current_code_audit.window_current_representation: normalized 32x32 float32 plus diagnostics and mock target_params
current_code_audit.window_target_representation: versioned raw 32x32 uint16 counts plus n_valid, observed health and CRC
current_code_audit.hidden_truth_rule: target_params is benchmark truth; only mock/oracle_delayed may consume it
